entries.wording: Electronic notification of order creation received.
entries.note: JS Express's first row: the shop's order data, before its warehouse has the parcel.
A partner's advice of the parcel's data, after the order and before JS Express's warehouse collects the parcel.
JS Express's warehouse took the parcel.
At JS Express's Chinese warehouse, after the outbound sorting scan and before the departure from origin.
The step after the allocation began, still before the departure from origin.

entries.wording: Arrive at international airport to abroad

entries.note: The flight's first landing, before a connecting flight.
The destination airport's ground handling agent reports the shipment arrived.

entries.wording: The goods have been picked up abroad
entries.note: The destination agent took the shipment from the airport; JS Express accepted the parcel long before.
The shipment entered a customs warehouse to wait for its clearance.
Relayed by ParcelsApp after the import release at the destination airport, before the destination courier has the parcel.

entries.wording: The cargo tally in the supervised warehouse is in progress.
entries.note: Relayed by ParcelsApp after the import release: the bonded warehouse counting the shipment's pieces, no new customs step.
Handed to the destination courier.

entries.wording: Package Received with Origin Scan warehouse
entries.note: The destination courier's first scan; the adapter moves the place the courier appends into the location.

entries.wording: Package is received at a Straightship station
entries.note: A Canadian courier's depot scan, with its place moved into the location.
GOFO's sorting scan in the United States, after the hand-off to the local courier.

entries.wording: Arrived at GOFO Regional Destination Facility

entries.note: GOFO's step at the delivering facility, before the courier takes the parcel out.
SpeedX's scans in the United States after the hand-off to it, relayed under JS Express's codes OIT and DOP, as SpeedX's own map reads them.
iMile's driver's reason for the attempt's end, relayed under the code DDE without iMile's centre in 【】.

SpeedX's note at 23:59 on a day it did not deliver the parcel, out for delivery or still at its facility, relayed under the code DDE. The next morning the facility processes the parcel and sends it out again, so it stays on its way, as SpeedX's own code 57409 reads.

entries.wording: Delivery failed, type: Recipient absent or address unreachable. We will redeliver as soon as possible. Please be patient and keep in touch.
entries.note: GOFO's failed attempt, with another one to come.

entries.wording: DESPATCHED AND ON ROUTE TO YODEL
entries.note: Yodel's record of the parcel on its way to it, written while JS Express's warehouse in China sent it out.
Yodel's record of its partner collecting the parcel from JS Express's warehouse in China, which accepted it the day before.
Yodel's agent taking the shipment from the destination airport.
Yodel's depot scan after the hand-off to the local courier.
Yodel's scan between its depots.
JS Express's warehouse in the destination country taking the parcel after customs.
That warehouse loading the parcel for the destination courier.
The truck leaving that warehouse; the place follows as the row's location.
The hand-over to the destination courier, before its first scan.
The destination courier's delivery, with its place moved into the location.
USPS's first scan after the hand-off to the local courier; JS Express accepted the parcel in China.
USPS's row between its facilities, as JS Express relays it.
USPS sends the parcel on to another address, as its own map reads it. Its forwarding alert, which names the time, day and town, is read by a rule in status.ts.
The delivering post office's arrival scan, before the parcel goes out for delivery.

entries.wording: The instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to DHL electronically.
entries.note: DHL's advice of the parcel's data, before JS Express's warehouse collects the parcel.

entries.wording: The shipment is in transit to DHL.
entries.note: DHL's record of the parcel on its way to it, written while JS Express's warehouse in China sorted it.

entries.wording: The shipment has been processed in the parcel center of origin
entries.note: DHL's first scan in Germany, after the hand-off to the local courier.

entries.wording: The shipment arrived in the region of recipient and will be transported to the delivery base in the next step.

entries.note: The delivering courier's depot, after the hand-off to the local courier and seconds before that courier's own acceptance scan.
A partner's record of the parcel's data, written while the parcel was already flying; it moves nothing.
A partner's record of the parcel's data, after JS Express's warehouse had collected the parcel and on another clock; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Shipping Label Created, USPS Awaiting Item
entries.note: USPS's record of the label, written while JS Express's warehouse in China had the parcel; it moves nothing.
A partner's record of the parcel's data, written after JS Express had the order; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Package information is created in the system
entries.note: The destination courier's record of the parcel's data, written days before it has the parcel; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Your package is being prepared by the sender and will be handed over to us soon
entries.note: A courier's record of the parcel's data, in its own voice, before JS Express hands the parcel over; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: E-MAIL NOTIFICATION HAS BEEN SENT TO THE RECIPIENT.
entries.note: A message to the recipient, not a scan; it moves nothing.
Straightship's driver's round, with its place moved into the location: a delivery or an attempt follows the same day, as Straightship's own map reads it.
The destination post's record of the label, at the instant of Colissimo's own, written while JS Express had the parcel; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Votre Colissimo va bientôt nous être confié ! Il est en cours de préparation chez votre expéditeur.
entries.note: Colissimo's record of the label, written while JS Express had the parcel; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Votre colis est en transit sur nos plateformes logistiques.
Votre Colissimo est en cours de traitement sur le site de tri local.
L'adresse indiquée sur votre colis est incomplète ou incorrecte. Nous procédons à sa correction afin de permettre le bon acheminement de votre colis.
entries.note: Colissimo corrects the address and carries on, as its own copy reads it.

entries.wording: Votre Colissimo n'a pas pu vous être livré en raison d'un problème d'adresse. Il va être retourné à l'expéditeur.
entries.note: A return announced: the parcel is not back with its sender yet.

entries.wording: Votre colis est sur son site de distribution. Nous le préparons pour le mettre en livraison.
entries.note: Colissimo's sort into the delivery round, as La Poste reads its code MD1.

entries.wording: Votre colis est livré à son expéditeur à la suite d'un retour.

entries.note: JS Express's own status in Chinese, arrived and awaiting collection, with the country for its place.

entries.wording: 收件人地址不详或有误，派送失败，逾期退回或销毁的具体费用以账单为准，麻烦让收件人联系下当地
entries.english: The recipient's address is unclear or wrong and the delivery failed. Charges for a return or disposal after the deadline follow the bill; the recipient should contact the local office
entries.note: JS Express's own notice after the destination courier's failed attempt, its local office's number cut: the parcel waits for the recipient's answer before it is returned or disposed of.

entries.wording: The delivery address is incorrect. Please ask the recipient to contact their local area?
entries.note: The English of JS Express's own notice after the destination courier's failed attempt, its local office's number cut.
A partner's record of the parcel's data at a European hub, which JS Express files with its own order notice, written while its warehouse in China had the parcel; it moves nothing.
The same partner's record a second after that data upload, at the same place and filed the same way; it moves nothing.
The European partner's hub scan after the hand-off to the local courier.
The partner sending the parcel on to the destination post.
The destination post receiving the parcel from abroad.

entries.wording: Your shipment has arrived at the postal operator of the country of destination and will be delivered in the coming days.

entries.note: The destination post's delivery office.

entries.wording: Not Delivered - Addressee not present- Message left
entries.note: The destination post's failed attempt, with a notice left; JS Express files it as a failed delivery.

entries.wording: Item arrival at collection point for pick-up
entries.note: The destination post's item waiting at its collection point; JS Express files it with its own arrived-and-awaiting-collection status (到达待取).
The Hungarian partner's hub after the hand-over to the local courier.
The same partner's line haul between its hub and a sorting centre.

entries.wording: Shipment arrived to sorting centre / Shipment in the sorting centre
entries.note: The same partner's sorting centre.
The destination courier's waybill, made while JS Express's warehouse in China still has the parcel; the waybill's reference can follow the wording.
JS Express's transit centre in China, between its sorting centre's outbound scan and the departure from origin.
The destination courier's transit hub, after the import release.
The destination courier's delivery task, after the hand-over to it and before its sorting.
The destination courier's sorting.
The destination courier's depot scanning the parcel out, before its delivery round.
The destination courier's record of a delivery preference the recipient chose, days before it has the parcel. It moves nothing.
SF Express's pickup at JS Express's Chinese hub, after the departure from origin: the line's carrier takes the parcel, not its acceptance.

entries.wording: Local courier has received the parcel
entries.note: The destination courier's receipt at the depot that delivers, between its sorting and its outbound scan, days after the hand-over to it.
SF Express weighing the parcel at its operation centre, beside its collection.

entries.wording: The shipment has been collected by SF Express
entries.note: The line's carrier took the parcel from JS Express's hub, after the departure from origin.

entries.wording: Shipment loaded, prepare to send to next station.
Shipment has arrived at the station and unloading.
Under customs clearance, please wait patiently.
entries.note: China's export customs at the departure airport, before the flight: in transit, not the destination's customs, which follows under OCP.
Import customs at the destination.
Import customs released the parcel.

entries.wording: Shipment in transit. Thanks for your waiting.

entries.note: The line's carrier at the destination, after its station's arrival and before any courier round: no round of its own.
The recipient refused the parcel on the delivery round; it goes back.
Back at the courier's sorting centre after the recipient refused the parcel, at the same second as that centre's arrival scan: the parcel goes back and has not reached the sender.
FedEx's label for the last leg, written before the order reaches JS Express's warehouse.
After the departure from origin and before export customs release the parcel: the pick-up for the flight.
Import customs released the parcel after the flight landed.
The destination's sorting facility after import clearance, before the local courier takes the parcel.
FedEx's hub on the line it delivers, relayed under JS Express's catch-all code.
FedEx's departure from its first facility, relayed under the same code.
FedEx's status between its facilities, the morning after the departure from its first one, relayed under the same code.

entries.wording: The instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to DHL electronically
entries.note: DHL's record of the sender's data on the line it delivers in Germany: no scan.

entries.wording: The shipment is in transit to DHL
entries.note: DHL's line for a parcel on its way to DHL's network from abroad.

entries.wording: Die Sendung wurde im Briefzentrum bearbeitet.
entries.note: DHL's mail centre in Germany sorting a small parcel, in German.
The delivering courier's hub, at the same second as "SHIPMENT PROCESSED": minutes before the courier's own takeover scan, then the next morning before the parcel leaves for the depot that delivers.
The same hub's processing, beside "PROCESSED AT HUB".
The delivering courier's hub receiving the parcel, seconds after it processed it and days after JS Express's warehouse collected it: no acceptance.
The courier's hub sending the parcel on to the depot that delivers.
The delivering courier's missed delivery, at the second of the courier's own scan for it.
The courier's second missed delivery.
The courier's third missed delivery, under the code JS Express also gives forwards, at the second of the courier's own scan saying the recipient must book a delivery.

The depot that delivers, minutes before each delivery round and again on the evening after a missed one: the courier's delivery depot, not a collection point. A notice that keeps the stage of the scan before it: in transit before a round, and after a missed delivery the miss, while the parcel waits for the next round or the recipient's request.
The delivering courier's exception at its transit hub, before any delivery round: no attempt, so an exception.

entries.wording: DELIVERY EXCEPTION, WAIT FOR INFORMATION CONFIRMATION
entries.note: The courier holding the parcel until its information is confirmed, listed after its warehouse arrival of the same second.
The delivering courier's warehouse taking the parcel back, listed before its exception of the same second, which keeps the parcel's stage.
The recipient's own arrangement after the third missed delivery, whose scan asked them to book one: the parcel moves on to it, so no longer a missed delivery.
The US delivery partner's first hub, by the airport the parcel flew to, after JS Express's hand-over to the local courier.
The US delivery partner's hub sends the parcel on to its last-mile warehouse.
The US delivery partner's last-mile warehouse, before the delivery round.
A note under OIT, hours after the parcel reached a USPS facility, while no scan follows: the parcel stays on its way.
